# Korea Visa Law — Kim & Hyun Law Office / 김앤현 법률사무소

> Public guidance from an independent Korean law office about visas, residence and entry refusal at Korean airports. The office is not an immigration authority. Admission, a visa, postponement of return or any other outcome is not guaranteed.

## Airport entry refusal

- [Denied entry at a Korean airport — English](https://koreavisalaw.com/en/entry-refusal): Current-status and document self-check, preparation examples, legal service scope, fees and contact options. For refusal during airport entry inspection, not an online K-ETA refusal.
- [한국 공항 입국불허 대응 — 한국어](https://koreavisalaw.com/ko/entry-refusal): 현재 상황·준비서류 점검, 쟁점별 자료 준비 예시, 업무 범위·비용과 연락 방법. 온라인 K-ETA 신청 거절과 공항 입국불허를 구별합니다.

The airport response package is USD 3,300 for up to 3 hours of attorney work in total. It includes review of refusal reasons and key records, one fact-finding call, one principal response document appropriate to the case, submission guidance and feasible initial contact, and a closing report. Airport attendance, interpretation, litigation and additional work require a separate agreement. Availability and the complete engagement terms are stated on the public service page and in the engagement process.

The self-check identifies preparation gaps; it does not predict admission or legal success. Document examples are not a universal mandatory airport checklist. Actual case documents are emailed to info@kimnhyun.com with the case reference after signing and paying; they are not uploaded to the website.

## Office and primary references

- [Kim & Hyun — official lawyer and office information](https://kimnhyun.com/about/)
- [대한민국 출입국·외국인정책본부 / Korea Immigration Service](https://www.immigration.go.kr/): Official immigration information.
- [출입국관리법 제12조 / Immigration Act, Article 12](https://www.law.go.kr/법령/출입국관리법/제12조): Korean statutory entry-inspection requirements; check the current law and applicable facts.
- [Korean Embassy in Nigeria — entry-refusal guidance](https://www.mofa.go.kr/ng-en/brd/m_23700/view.do?seq=31): Official explanation of entry inspection and supporting records.
- [Public sitemap](https://koreavisalaw.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical public pages; account, contract, payment and case-record pages are excluded.
